answer: Locks are recorded in relic, expire in ocean, and canyon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 123 aliases therefore needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2066 identities would post 4747 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
